entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gra Rueb was a Dutch sculptor. Her work was part of the sculpture event in the art competition at the 1928 Summer Olympics. Rueb's work was included in the 1939 exhibition and sale Onze Kunst van Heden at the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam.
